name: Helpjuice
description: Helpjuice is a knowledge base platform for creating, managing, and sharing searchable help centers and internal documentation.

events.d: Create a new article with content, categories and visibility.
Permanently delete an article by its ID.
Update an article's selected fields. Choose which fields to change and provide users by email or ID.
List or search articles, or get one by ID; supports filters, date ranges, and pagination.
Create a new category or sub-category.
Update an existing category. Only filled fields are changed.
Retrieve all categories or a single category by ID; filter by language, segments, and paginate results.
Create a new user with first and last name, email, role, and optional groups (multi-select).
Update an existing user by ID or email. Change email, first/last name, role, or groups.
Retrieve users with optional filters for email, name, groups, or role.
Create a group with a name, enable Smart Load, add user IDs, or set auto-group email extensions.
Retrieve all groups from your Helpjuice account.
Permanently delete a group by its ID, optionally deleting its users too.
Permanently delete a user from your Helpjuice account by user ID.
Permanently delete a category by its ID.
